title: fix(plugin-detail,app-shell): build record titles from the fields the viewer may read (objectui#10434)
body:
Fixes #10434

Clause-②: no. No declared key, schema, export or accept set moves. The new `withoutDeniedFields` helper in `@object-ui/plugin-detail` is not re-exported from the package entry, and the copy in `RecordDetailView.tsx` is module-private. What moves is which value a title prints.

## What changed

A record's title is now built from the record as the viewer may read it. The fields the loaded permission policy denies are removed first, with `id` and `_id` kept. What is left is the row ObjectStack's `FieldMasker` already serves. A denied field then reads exactly as an absent one, and the title ladder falls through to its next rung. There is no placeholder mask.

Each host is gated where it computes the title, with the objectui#10411 check (`!perms.isLoaded || perms.checkField(object, field, 'read')`):

- **`DetailView` header** (`packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx`). `resolveDisplayTitle` now receives `titleRow`, a `useMemo` over `data`, `perms` and the object name. That covers every rung that reads the record: the view `primaryField`, the declared name pointer, `titleFormat`, the ADR-0079 resolver and the record-key probe.
- **`record:details` title dedupe** (`packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-details.tsx`). The dedupe reads the same gated row, so it hides the row the fallen-through H1 shows. It is computed in render after the renderer's early returns, so it takes no memo: a hook there would break the hook order. `perms` is read on every render.
- **Record page title** (`packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`). The breadcrumb, favourite and "Recently Accessed" title effect only. `perms` and `objectName` joined its deps.

**Where the helper lives.** It is in `packages/plugin-detail/src/withoutDeniedFields.ts`, because the two plugin-detail hosts would otherwise spell it twice. `RecordDetailView.tsx` already imports from `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, but the helper is not on that package's entry, and exporting it would widen a published surface. So `RecordDetailView.tsx` keeps its own module-private copy. That is the one-copy-per-file choice objectui#10411 made for `LookupField` and `RecordPickerDialog`.

`packages/core/src/utils/record-title.ts` is untouched.

## Mechanism assumptions, measured

- **A1 (the ladder falls through): holds.** `formatTitleTemplate` reads a missing key as empty. It becomes the empty token and is stripped with its orphan separator. Every `getRecordDisplayName` rung reads through `recordDisplayValueAt`, which answers `undefined` for a missing key. So a denied key behaves exactly as an absent one. A partly denied template renders what the same template renders with the key absent: `{name} - {email}` gives `Ada Lovelace`, and `{name} ({email})` gives `Ada Lovelace ()`, because parentheses are not in the separator class. The second is also what a stripping backend renders today, so it follows the triage's rule, and no new rule was invented. It is pinned as an equivalence (the denied heading equals the stripping backend's heading), not as a wanted string.
- **A2 (an unloaded policy filters nothing): holds, pinned.** With no provider mounted, `isLoaded` is false and the headings are `ada@example.com` and `Ada Lovelace - ada@example.com`, the served row's titles. The helper hands back the same object when it withholds nothing.
- **A3 (the dedupe path): holds with the block's own header, and is partly falsified under `page:header`.** See the next section.
- **A4 (`id` stays): holds, pinned.** With every field denied, `id` included, the heading is `Record #K1`, not `Details`. Removing the `id` exemption turns exactly that pin red (Expected `Record #K1`, Received `Details`).

## A3 in detail: which H1 the dedupe agrees with

With `showHeader: true`, `record:details` draws `DetailView`'s own header, which is now gated. The gated dedupe hides the `name` row that the fallen-through H1 shows. Reading the raw row printed `Ada Lovelace` twice, once in the H1 and once as a row. That is the ablation's red.

The synthesized default page composes `page:header` over `record:details`. `page:header` is `PageHeaderRenderer` in `@object-ui/components`, which is ungated and out of scope. A scratch probe measured that composition (not committed). The policy denies `email`, and the backend does not strip:

| title source | `page:header` H1 | body before (raw dedupe) | body now (gated dedupe) | stripping backend |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `titleFormat: '{email}'` | `ada@example.com` | Name, Phone | Phone | Phone, under H1 `Ada Lovelace` |
| `titleFormat: '{name} - {email}'` | `Ada Lovelace - ada@example.com` | Name, Phone | Phone | Phone, under H1 `Ada Lovelace` |
| `nameField: 'email'` | `ada@example.com` | Name, Phone | Phone | Phone, under H1 `Ada Lovelace` |

So in that composition, on a backend that does not strip, the `name` row is now hidden while the ungated H1 prints the denied email. For the first and third rows, the readable name is then on screen nowhere. The body now equals the stripping backend's body. On ObjectStack, which strips, nothing changes. The disagreement exists because `page:header` is not gated, and it closes when that host is gated (see the notes below). Keeping the dedupe raw would instead print the name row twice under `DetailView`'s own header. The report puts this to the seat as an open question.

## Pins (real `PermissionProvider`)

- `packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/DetailView.titleFls-10434.test.tsx` (10 tests). A denied `titleFormat` token, `nameField` or view `primaryField` does not print, and the heading falls through to `name`. DENIED READS AS ABSENT over four templates. The `id` floor. Two controls: a policy denying an unrelated field, and no provider.
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-details.titleFls-10434.test.tsx` (10 tests). With the block's own header, the H1 falls through to `name` and prints it once, for a denied token, a composite and a denied pointer. DENIED READS AS ABSENT for the whole block, with and without its header. Two controls.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.titleFls-10434.test.tsx` (4 tests). A denied token or pointer never reaches the published breadcrumb title (every published value is recorded) and it falls through to `name`. Two controls.

## Reverse proofs

Each proof ran through `ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed tree `cc65f5a43`. Every anchor hit 1 and went to 0, and every restore ended with the blob equal to `HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

- **`DetailView` gate removed** (`resolveDisplayTitle(data, …)`): 13 red, 11 green. The red are the 8 `DetailView` denied pins and the 5 `record:details` pins that read `DetailView`'s own H1 (3 WITH ITS OWN HEADER and 2 DENIED READS AS ABSENT with the header on). This is wider than "exactly that host's pins", because those `record:details` pins read that H1 by construction. The controls and every `RecordDetailView` pin stay green.
- **`record:details` gate removed:** 8 red, 16 green. The red are exactly the 8 `record:details` denied pins. All `DetailView` and `RecordDetailView` pins stay green.
- **`RecordDetailView` gate removed:** 2 red, 22 green. The red are exactly its two denied pins.
- **`id` exemption removed from the helper:** 1 red, 9 green (the `id` floor pin).

## Verification

The full runs were at `863b60345`. The only later commit, `664774d7a`, changes comments in `record-details.tsx` only, and the renderer suites and the pins were rerun on it.

- All of `packages/plugin-detail/`: 205 files passed and 1 skipped. 2045 tests passed and 8 skipped.
- The app-shell suites naming `DetailView`, `record-details`, `RecordDetailView`, `resolveDisplayTitle`, `formatTitleTemplate` or `titleFormat`: 65 files, 653 tests passed.
- Every other suite naming those, including the source-text readers: 79 files, 2011 tests passed.
- At `664774d7a`: `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/` and the three pin files, 62 files, 702 tests passed.
- Closure builds with turbo at concurrency 2: `@object-ui/plugin-detail^...` 11/11, and `@object-ui/app-shell^...` 28/28, which builds plugin-detail itself.
- `type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): plugin-detail exit 0, app-shell exit 0. `--listFiles` shows the new tests in both test programs.
- Gates, all exit 0: `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check-changeset-overwrite` (report-only; it reports the 9436 edit), `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:phantom-deps` and `check:self-import`. `check:changeset-claims` flagged the 7997, 8400 and 8649 changesets, and all three paragraphs were read and are still true.
- eslint on the touched files: 0 errors. The one warning on a changed line is the existing `const data: any` annotation.
- Not run locally, and left to CI: the repo-wide `pnpm lint`, the `pnpm test` shards and Build and E2E.

**Changeset.** `.changeset/10434-record-title-fls.md` declares a `patch` for `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/app-shell`. This PR also corrects one pending body, `.changeset/9436-detail-declared-pointer-order.md`, whose front matter is byte-identical. Its two sentences on `DetailView` and the dedupe now say that a denied `primaryField` or pointer falls through as if blank, and that the dedupe's pointer branch needs a value the viewer may read.

## Acceptance notes

These are out of scope. They were measured and not edited.

- **`page:header`** (`packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`). `@object-ui/components` has no `@object-ui/permissions` dependency. The probe above shows the H1 printing a denied `titleFormat` token or pointer on a backend that does not strip.
- **Search labels.** `CommandPalette`, `SearchResultsPage` and `global-search-renderer` pass `getRecordDisplayName` as `getDisplayName` to `useRecordSearch`, which labels hits from the served row. None of the four files reads a permission (grep: no `usePermissions` and no `checkField`). A scratch renderHook probe with `CommandPalette`'s exact wiring, under the real `PermissionProvider` denying `email` and `titleFormat: '{email}'`, labels the hit `ada@example.com`.
- **Lookup cell** (`resolveLookupRecordName` in `packages/fields/src/index.tsx`). A scratch probe renders `ada@example.com` for an expanded record whose referenced object's `titleFormat` names a field the policy denies on that object.
- **`LookupField.tsx`** is held by objectui#10343 (seat 2). objectui#10411 already gates its option label.
- **Docs.** The plugin-detail README's `primaryField` example comment still describes the key correctly. No README or guide sentence describes how permissions affect the header title, so no doc went false.
- **Sequencing.** The triage asked for this card and objectui#10360 to go one after the other, since both edit the dedupe. objectui#10360 is closed as completed, and the gated row now feeds its scan. Draft PR objectui#8941's one-line icon change in `DetailView.tsx` does not overlap this diff.
